notes.title: The End of Gameplay
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=g_kQLrBSrt0;full][/previewyoutube]

The End of Gameplay on Steam

hi! droqen here! i'm going to do another announcement when the game comes out, too, but i'm reaching out to as many people as possible about my new game because... well, actually, it's really quite scary, and i wanted to release it to as few people as possible, but then i did that, and then i showed it to a few more people, and then a few more, and i started yelling "kill gameplay" on bluesky...

it got away from me, and now this half-poem half-rant half-platformer of a videogame, which i want to describe as "like Starseed Pilgrim, but only all the parts that nobody told me they cared about," is a thing that i'm releasing to the world in a few weeks.

on the full flower moon in may.

i think of starseed pilgrim as a game that is enjoyed, mostly, by indie game devs, and this new game is even more down that rabbithole. you can tell from the title, it is about gameplay, it is something. if you want to kill gameplay too or you just want to bathe in the blood of its ending or you just want to watch in horror, maybe this game of a poem will be for you.

so, yeah, go check out my steam page for The End of Gameplay. help me with the meta-game i'm playing right now, "releasing a game on steam", make my numbers go up! put me on your wishlist!

love, droqen


 oh and if you REALLY want to help me with my game of number-go-up, you can rebleet my announcement on bluesky! here


thanks and see you in around a moon cycle when my game comes out!!1

notes.title: hello it's time to revisit Starseed Pilgrim, after 6.5 years!
notes.content:
Hi! I'm a nomadic indie dev once more after years of other stuff, and trying to find my path again. Right now I'm working on a port of Starseed Pilgrim to Unity, with the potential future goals:
- Putting it on other platforms
- Putting out a nicer version that will run better on future computers and support controllers and have a pause button etc
- Adding things to it if I think of anything particularly appropriate and juicy to add to it
- Possibly re-using the engine for a proper sequel, again this is if I think of anything particularly appropriate and juicy and sequel-worthy to even build in the first place.

I started a Patreon a few weeks ago. If you're interested in a closer look at what i'm up to - this Starseed Pilgrim project and whatever comes after it! - please check it out: https://www.patreon.com/droqen (you can join a discord and chat me up about game shit!)

Also, I got my mailing list back online. If you want to keep an eye on my proper releases, the signup is on my website: http://www.droqen.com/



Finally, thank you so much for all the kind words and generous thoughts about Starseed Pilgrim over the years! I hope to make something twice as good and at least half as popular before I die.
